verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud platform, since its console, CLI, or agents could offer such a control, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only telemetry mention describes monitoring dashboards for customer fleet hardware, and the billing usage views are an adjacent feature, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
